behaviour: A bright, hot, fragrant paste of fresh green chilli and aromatics. It is fried in fat or in the thick top of coconut milk until its raw edge is gone, then thinned into a sauce.

contains.basis: Recorded strictly: most are made with shrimp paste.
Recorded strictly: some are made with fish sauce.

stands_in_for.caveat: Thai green curry paste is a different seasoning and does not thicken like a Japanese curry block.
Green curry paste fries in much the same way but gives a different curry without the warm, toasted spice character of massaman.
